faqs.a:
This article applies to any existing or future drinking water service line connections
               to buildings or structures that receive water service directly from the city's water
               utility and does not apply to structures within consecutive water systems receiving
               city finished water or city residents not on city water.
(
Ord. No. 4869
, § 1, 3-4-2024)
